exchange_contract.reported_by: Main (verify-codex-compaction-chain-fail-closed.ts aborted in the cold scenario)
exchange_contract.symptom: CodexCompactionChainLostError: chained compaction failed after 1 attempts: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'ids.some') at compaction-v2-streaming.ts chainLossOr/requestCompactionV2Streaming.
exchange_contract.root_cause: 18.3.3 changed CodexWebSocketConnection.streamRequest from a bare request body (18.2.10) to a CodexWebSocketExchange union ({ send } | { attachSteerIds }); 0070's chain-recovery frame was still a bare body, so `"send" in exchange` was false, the stream took the attach branch and dereferenced undefined ids in hasFailedSteer.
exchange_contract.fix: Recovery frame is now { send: { ...recoveryBody, type: "response.create", generate: false } }. All three .streamRequest( call sites audited; recovery was the only non-conforming one.
exchange_contract.evidence: fault-tree probe reproduced Main's message verbatim pre-fix (same stack frames, same 'ids.some' text) and passes post-fix.

open_stage_metadata_restore.root_cause: getOrCreateCodexWebSocketConnection registers onHandshakeHeaders -> updateCodexSessionMetadataFromHeaders, which writes turnState.value and modelsEtag on the WS 101. 0070's rollback only existed in streamCodexCompactionEvents' finally, so a failure before that generator exists (chain recovery, send-point refusal, dead socket) kept metadata minted for a response that never completed.
open_stage_metadata_restore.fix: The pre-open snapshot is now the named closure restoreOpenStageMetadata; the open catch calls it, and streamCodexCompactionEvents' incomplete-drain finally restores the PRE-open snapshot (previously the post-open value, which could already carry a handshake write).

collector_rejection_rollback.root_cause: The generator can drain a valid terminal (completed -> its finally does not run) and pi-agent-core then rejects the summary in finishCompactionV2Collection (zero/multiple compaction items, missing terminal). onAccept is never called, so neither the open catch nor the generator finally undid the 101 metadata.
collector_rejection_rollback.fix: OpenAICodexCompactionStreamOptions.onAccept now receives (commit, rollback); pi-agent-core calls rollback() in the catch around collectCompactionV2Events. The append baseline is deliberately untouched, so a rejected summary keeps its chain (the gate's canAppend assertion still holds). d.ts carries the same two-parameter signature.

evidence: Fault-tree probe fault/pi-ai/probe-0070-recovery.ts - seven scenarios PASS on the fixed tree: cold recovery is exchange-wrapped and chains on the recovered baseline on the same socket with zero HTTP sends; recovery returning model output fails closed; preferWebsockets:false fails closed with no frame; invalid_request_error stays terminal with its code and no retry; a failed open leaves no 101 metadata; a collector-rejected summary leaves no 101 metadata; an accepted summary keeps it.

Control A (only the pi-agent-core rollback() call removed): collector-rejection scenario fails with 'a rejected summary must not keep the turn state its 101 committed', failed-open scenario still passes - proves the rejection hook is load-bearing on its own.
Control B (restore body disabled): failed-open scenario fails with 'a failed open must not keep the turn state its 101 committed' - proves the open-stage restore is load-bearing.

The fixture mints the session cell at upgrade time because Bun 1.3.14 hides handshake response headers from the client (measured: event.responseHeaders/headers/response and socket.responseHeaders/handshakeHeaders/response all null), so a real 101 cannot deliver x-codex-turn-state/x-models-etag in-process.

Every fix was applied through tools/fix-0070-*.py (idempotent) before regenerating the candidate, so 0070 is still a real before/after diff and Main's normalized comments are preserved; 0063/0068/0069 were regenerated byte-identically and not rewritten.

main_owned_assets_to_update.gate_fixture: verify-codex-compaction-chain-fail-closed.ts needs an upgrade-time mint of the session turn-state cell plus hasTurnState assertions on invalid-summary/failed-open (false) and success (true); without it those assertions are vacuous because nothing writes turnState through a real 101 on Bun 1.3.14. Snippet and the codexCompaction trap (createCodexRequestMetadata clears turnStates when startNewTurn is inferred) were sent to Main.
fault_anchors: verify-codex-compaction-chain-fail-closed-faults.sh line 42 ("missing acceptance type") still matches the old single-line onAccept declaration; retarget the three-line form or the unique fragment '        rollback: () => void,'.

verify-codex-compaction-chain-fail-closed-faults.sh line 48 ("accepted metadata dropped") matches '\t\tapplyOpenAICodexCompactionResponseMetadata(recorded, requestContext);' which is now indented one level deeper inside options.onAccept?.(recorded => {.
No other fault anchor in that file is affected; the gate's one-parameter type probe still type-checks, and extending it with onAccept(commit, rollback) would cover the new surface.
main_owned_assets_to_update.consumer_probe: Suggested gate probe for the new declaration: import { buildCodexChainedRequestBody } from the package declaration entry point (AI_ROOT/dist/types/providers/openai-codex-responses.js), assert `typeof buildCodexChainedRequestBody === 'function'` and type-check a call with a structurally shaped state variable (canAppend plus the optional baseline fields). A one-parameter or structurally narrower argument type is accepted, so passing the provider's own state object still type-checks.

0063_live_chain_baseline: buildCodexChainedRequestBody is exported (patches/verify-codex-compaction-chain.ts imports it from the selected AI root) and, for a body whose last input item is a compaction_trigger with a usable baseline, returns the LIVE baseline verbatim ({...state.lastRequest, client_metadata from the compaction body, previous_response_id: state.lastResponseId}); the rebuilt transcript's own top-level options (tool_choice/store/stream/instructions/tools) never reach the wire.

Calls the baseline left unanswered are paired by call_id: the transcript's recorded *_call_output is forwarded verbatim, otherwise a matching-kind placeholder output is synthesized, with the trigger kept last.

A computer_call with no recorded screenshot result breaks the chain (resetCodexWebSocketAppendState + modelsEtag cleared) rather than shipping a frame the endpoint rejects; an answered computer_call still chains.

Codex V2 compaction never keys the Lite socket: pi-agent-core compaction.ts and compaction-v2-streaming.ts pin responsesLite:false so the request reaches the live turn's WebSocket session key where previous_response_id resolves.
OpenAICodexResponsesOptions.responsesLite documents that provider-native compaction stays on the full transport.
0068_stale_baseline_reconnect: The chain decision follows the socket: canAppendBeforeRequest + buildCodexChainedRequestBody moved AFTER getOrCreateCodexWebSocketConnection settles, so an auth refresh, stale-reuse or reconnect cannot be raced (TOCTOU) into shipping a dead previous_response_id.

18.3.3's steering lifecycle is preserved untouched: acceptedSteering capture, the replaced-socket identity check (steered.connection === websocketConnection), planSteeredRequest attach/create/discard branches and the replacement getOrCreate all stay; only the two chain-decision statements moved.

OpenAICodexCompactionStreamOptions.requestDiagnostics reports the wire shape actually sent; the try/finally publishes only a lastTurn reference this open recorded, so an attempt that died before sending cannot inherit the previous turn's shape.
The compaction stream's SSE fallback path samples diagnostics across openCodexSseTransport and publishes only a newly recorded shape.

traceCompaction moved to the new module pi-agent-core/src/compaction/compaction-trace.ts so compaction-v2-streaming can emit per-attempt records without a module-init cycle; the summarize.usage (codex-v2) row carries transport/chained/canAppend/inputItems.
0069_effort_history: OpenAIResponsesHistoryPayload gains effortControl (durable request baseline + historical effort changes, never sent as a history item).

The process-local effortControls map is removed from the Codex provider session state; the baseline is restored from the current branch's last matching assistant message (api/model/provider match, stopReason not error/aborted) through providerPayload.effortControl, structured-cloned so a persisted branch snapshot is never mutated, else a fresh control state is created.
The resolved effort still runs through planStableOpenAIEffort and the control state is written back onto output.providerPayload so resume and branch switches keep the same request prefix.

The only 18.3.3 strict failure was the second types.ts / types.d.ts hunk: upstream inserted AnthropicOutputEffort / AnthropicToolChange / AnthropicMessagePayload between the payload interface and the old trailing context. Both are re-anchored here with every upstream type preserved; the branch-local effort wire semantics are unchanged.
0070_fail_closed_chain: A Codex V2 compaction request never degrades into a full-price SSE replay: openInitialCodexEventStream throws CodexCompactionChainLostError when the WebSocket open path fails (retryable=!isFatal) and when no WebSocket transport was even attempted; the compaction stream rethrows WebSocket transport errors instead of taking the silent SSE fallback.

The send point fails closed: with mustChain true (isCompactionWireBody) and a settled frame lacking previous_response_id, the frame is never written and the error carries a diagnosis assembled from samples taken before/after getOrCreate and after buildCodexChainedRequestBody (socket state, canAppend at each point, lastResponseId, prewarmed, fallbackCount, lastTransport, wsRetry, lastClose/lastPeerClose age+generation).

A lost baseline is recovered before the throw: with a compaction body and no usable baseline a non-generating `generate:false` response.create rebuilds it (request.prepareCompactionRecovery supplies the live message prefix when available, else the trigger is trimmed off). The frame is sent as the 18.3.3 WebSocket exchange (`{ send: ... }`; the union also carries the `{ attachSteerIds }` steering form). Model output, incomplete/failed response, dead socket or missing response id all fail closed; on success lastRequest/lastResponseId/lastResponseItems/canAppend are re-armed for the next chained request.

Session metadata and append-baseline invalidation are deferred to acceptance: the collector records response.metadata frames while draining and the provider's onAccept callback applies turnState/modelsEtag and resets this socket's append state only after the summary is accepted, so a failed attempt cannot poison sticky routing state or destroy the retry baseline.

Socket departures are observable: CodexWebSocketConnection gains a generation id plus onClosed, reporting local teardown and peer closes separately (first close wins per socket, identity-guarded so a replaced socket's async close cannot wipe its replacement's baseline); both obituaries are cleared once a new chain exists.

WebSocket fallback is attempt-local: disableWebsocket is removed (a failed attempt no longer disables the transport for the session); websocketDisabled is still reported for provider details and is always false.

Chain classification keeps the provider's own code: CompactionV2StreamFailure carries code + chainLost, the type:"error" frame is no longer flattened into the generic truncated-stream message, and isRetryableCompactionError separates permanent codes, chain rejections and transient WebSocket/parse failures.

compaction-v2-streaming refuses the Codex V2 endpoint when the provider transport cannot be used at all (throws CodexCompactionChainLostError instead of building compatibility metadata or SSE headers), tracks sawChainedAttempt across retries and escalates the final error to the sentinel.

compaction.ts never falls back to V1 for Codex (a failed Codex V2 compaction throws the sentinel); SummaryOptions.initiator plus initiator/sessionId on the codex-v2 trace rows keep a process's primary and advisors attributable.

session-maintenance skips a Codex remote speculation outright (it runs on an isolated :spec: session over SSE, where no chain can exist), lets a recoverable chain loss bypass the timeout branch, drives the retry decision from CodexCompactionChainLostError.retryable, rethrows CompactionCancelledError, and names the next method in the fallback notice.
session-advisors passes initiator:`advisor:${advisor.slug}` so an advisor compaction is not attributed to the primary session.
